title: Hybrid search and RRF
text: Hybrid search combines semantic vector similarity and keyword full-text retrieval inside one database query. Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) merges ranked signals within seekdb instead of merging two lists in the browser.

title: WebGPU acceleration
text: WebGPU accelerates neural network embedding inference on a supported device GPU. Transformers.js can explicitly select the WebGPU backend for faster local inference without a cloud AI API.

title: WebAssembly fallback
text: When WebGPU is unavailable, the application falls back to the WebAssembly WASM execution backend. The embedding model still runs entirely in the browser, with slower CPU execution depending on hardware.

title: INT8 quantization
text: INT8 quantization maps model parameters to eight-bit values, reducing model file size and often download time. Quality should be evaluated using fixed test questions and Recall at K and nDCG at K, not assumed identical.

title: FP16 half precision
text: FP16 stores floating point weights with sixteen bits instead of thirty two. WebGPU can often run a half precision embedding model while preserving much of its semantic quality, but hardware support varies.

title: Index maintenance
text: A database vector index provides approximate nearest-neighbor search. After incremental document insertion the application should verify that the new document is visible to subsequent hybrid search before reporting success.

title: Document metadata
text: Each knowledge base stores original document text, a stable document identifier, title, source metadata, and a 384-dimensional dense embedding vector in seekdb collections.

title: Knowledge base isolation
text: Collections must keep separate knowledge bases and model precision variants. The same dataset embedded with FP32 and INT8 should use distinct collections to prevent inconsistent vector-space comparisons.

title: Browser-only inference
text: Local embedding means the text is converted to vectors by the user's own browser. The server receives client-computed vectors for database storage and search, and never calls an external model inference service.

title: Batch embedding
text: Batching multiple text segments into a single local model inference call can improve embedding throughput. Compare batch size one against batch size eight under fixed hardware and dataset conditions.

title: Cold and warm latency
text: Cold inference includes downloading and initializing model weights and initial compilation. Warm performance measurements should exclude one-time model loading and report median latency across multiple queries.

title: Retrieval quality metrics
text: Recall at K measures the fraction of relevant documents found in the first K results. Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain nDCG at K additionally accounts for how high relevant documents appear in a ranked list.

title: seekdb data engine
text: seekdb is a MySQL-compatible data engine with dense vector indexes, full-text indexing and hybrid retrieval. The seekdb JavaScript SDK exposes a collection.hybridSearch function with RRF ranking.

title: ONNX Runtime Web
text: ONNX Runtime Web executes exported ONNX neural networks within a browser. Transformers.js uses it to perform tokenization and feature extraction locally with WebGPU or WASM backends.

title: Continuous text imports
text: Incremental import appends new text chunks into an existing seekdb collection. After the write is committed and the hybrid index has caught up, fresh content should become retrievable without reimporting earlier documents.

title: Model download versus inference
text: Downloading a public model from Hugging Face does not mean remote inference occurs. After downloading ONNX weights, the browser performs the actual numerical embedding calculation on the user's device.
